description: This file implements the MDBBackend class for managing MCP tools and communication, including methods for initializing, listing tools, calling tools, and managing backend lifecycle. It also includes functions for running the backend server and handling pause events, with related classes and schema definitions.

classes.name: MDBBackend
classes.description: Backend class managing MCP tools, communication stack, and server lifecycle.

classes.name: OnceTimeServerBackendWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for a server backend that allows self-destruction after a single use.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend, establishing transport and client connection.

methods.name: listTools
methods.description: Returns a list of available MCP tools.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Calls a specified MCP tool with arguments, handling stack and interruption.

methods.name: _client
methods.description: Retrieves the current client from the stack.

methods.name: _pushTools
methods.description: Pushes MCP tools to the stack using a provided URL.

methods.name: _pushClient
methods.description: Adds a new client to the stack with a transport and optional intro message.

methods.name: waitForClosed
methods.description: Waits for the backend to be self-destructed.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Constructs MDBBackend with a top-level backend.
